First-Party Plan Support
────────────────────────────────────────
ULID:      01KGKSNZQJ7KKJ747VXPBMX9TP
Slugs:     plan-support
Type:      feature
Tags:      planning, shadow, agent-first

─── Description ───
Plans are durable artifacts that capture implementation context, approach, and rationale before translating to specs and tasks. They persist in the shadow branch, link to derived work, and provide auditable planning history.

─── Acceptance Criteria ───
  [ac-1]
    Given: A user wants to create a plan
    When: kspec plan add --title "Title" --content "Markdown content" is run
    Then: A plan is created with ULID, stored in project.plans.yaml, and auto-committed to shadow branch
  [ac-2]
    Given: A markdown file exists at a path
    When: kspec plan add --title "Title" --content-file ./plan.md is run
    Then: File content is read and stored as plan content
  [ac-3]
    Given: A plan exists in draft status
    When: kspec plan set @plan --status approved is run
    Then: Status is updated to approved and approved_at timestamp is set
  [ac-4]
    Given: A plan is in completed or rejected status
    When: kspec plan set @plan --status draft is run
    Then: Command fails with exit code 5 (conflict) and message Cannot transition from terminal status
  [ac-5]
    Given: An approved or active plan exists
    When: kspec plan derive @plan is run
    Then: A task is created with plan_ref pointing to the plan, the plan's derived_tasks array is updated, and plan transitions to active if not already
  [ac-6]
    Given: A task was derived from a plan
    When: kspec task get @task or kspec plan get @plan is run
    Then: Both display the bidirectional link (task shows plan_ref, plan shows derived_tasks)
  [ac-7]
    Given: Multiple plans exist in various states
    When: kspec plan list [--status <filter>] is run
    Then: Plans are listed with title, status, derived task count, and timestamps
  [ac-8]
    Given: A plan exists
    When: kspec plan get @plan is run
    Then: Full plan displayed: title, status, content (markdown), linked tasks, timestamps
  [ac-9]
    Given: A plan exists
    When: kspec plan note @plan "Progress note..." is run
    Then: Note is appended to plan's notes array with ULID, timestamp, and author
  [ac-10]
    Given: A task has plan_ref pointing to a non-existent plan
    When: kspec validate is run
    Then: Validation warns about dangling plan reference
  [ac-11]
    Given: A plan file with ## Specs YAML block exists
    When: kspec plan import <path> is run
    Then: Specs are parsed from YAML, validated against schema, and created in order (parents before children)
  [ac-12]
    Given: A plan file with derive_from_specs: true in Tasks section
    When: kspec plan import <path> is run
    Then: Tasks are auto-derived from each created spec, with plan_ref linking to imported plan
  [ac-13]
    Given: A plan file has ## Implementation Notes section
    When: Specs and tasks are auto-created
    Then: Implementation notes are added as initial note to all derived tasks
  [ac-14]
    Given: A plan contains a spec with slug that already exists
    When: kspec plan import <path> is run (no flags)
    Then: Existing spec is skipped with warning, other specs still created
  [ac-15]
    Given: A plan file with specs and tasks
    When: kspec plan import <path> --dry-run is run
    Then: Shows what would be created without making changes, exits with code 0
  [ac-16]
    Given: A plan with spec cli-traits that references parent @json-output (defined earlier in same plan)
    When: kspec plan import <path> is run
    Then: Specs are created in topological order (parents before children), local refs resolved against newly-created specs
  [ac-17]
    Given: A plan with spec referencing parent @nonexistent (not in plan, not in project)
    When: kspec plan import <path> is run
    Then: Error Parent @nonexistent not found, that spec is skipped, other valid specs still created
  [ac-18]
    Given: A plan where spec A has parent @B and spec B has parent @A
    When: kspec plan import <path> is run
    Then: Error Circular parent reference: @A -> @B -> @A, import aborts before creating specs
  [ac-19]
    Given: A plan with derive_from_specs: true and specs json-output and cli-traits
    When: kspec plan import <path> is run
    Then: Each derived task has spec_ref pointing to source spec AND plan_ref pointing to imported plan
  [ac-20]
    Given: A plan with derive_from_specs: true and spec titled JSON Output Mode
    When: kspec plan import <path> is run
    Then: Derived task has title Implement JSON Output Mode (matching kspec derive convention)
  [ac-21]
    Given: A plan file with malformed YAML in Specs section
    When: kspec plan import <path> is run
    Then: Error with line number and parser message, exit code 2 (USAGE)
  [ac-22]
    Given: A plan spec entry missing required title field
    When: kspec plan import <path> is run
    Then: Error Spec at index N missing required field: title, that spec skipped
  [ac-23]
    Given: A plan with 5 specs where 2 have errors and 3 are valid
    When: kspec plan import <path> is run
    Then: 3 valid specs created, exit code 0 (success), output shows Created 3 specs, 2 errors with error details
  [ac-24]
    Given: A plan file is successfully imported
    When: Import completes
    Then: Plan record added to project.plans.yaml with status active, source path, list of created spec/task refs
  [ac-25]
    Given: A plan previously imported (specs @json-output and @cli-traits exist)
    When: kspec plan import <path> is run again
    Then: Existing specs skipped with message, no duplicates, exit code 0
  [ac-26]
    Given: A previously imported plan where @json-output has changed content
    When: kspec plan import <path> --update is run
    Then: Existing spec @json-output is updated to match plan, message Updated @json-output
  [ac-27]
    Given: A plan with additional tasks array in Tasks section (tasks without specs)
    When: kspec plan import <path> is run
    Then: Manual tasks are created without spec_ref, only with plan_ref
  [ac-28]
    Given: A plan has been imported with slug auth-redesign
    When: @auth-redesign is used in any kspec command
    Then: Reference resolves to the plan (ReferenceIndex includes plans)
  [ac-29]
    Given: A plan with 5 specs where 2 have validation errors
    When: kspec plan import <path> is run (default behavior)
    Then: Valid specs are created, errors logged, exit code 0 with summary output
  [ac-30]
    Given: A plan exists
    When: kspec plan get @plan --json is run
    Then: Output is valid JSON with all plan fields (title, status, content, derived_tasks, timestamps)
  [ac-31]
    Given: Multiple plans exist
    When: kspec plan list --json is run
    Then: Output is JSON array of plan objects with summary fields
  [ac-32]
    Given: A plan file is imported

    Then: Output is JSON with created specs, tasks, and any errors

    Then: Message includes recovery hint: Check parent exists or define it earlier in plan
